brief:
今日财经的主线是"AI 资本开支"的两面：一面是需求看不到顶——美银预计全球数据中心支出到 2028 年将翻倍至约 2.1 万亿美元，亚马逊 CEO 贾西则直言 AWS 的 2026 年容量已售罄、2027 年基本售罄、2028 年也已有相当部分被预定；另一面是摩擦开始显性化——Meta 财报虽强、还推出新类别股票，但旗下 Muse 模型同时曝出数据泄露，公司又在出版方、广告主及一名参议员反对后推迟了新的商业条款。企业软件侧的挤压同样写进了财报：Infosys 因客户预算从传统外包转向 AI 项目而下调全年指引，北美业务放缓加深；美国运通虽上调 2026 年利润预期，却计划裁减约 5% 的员工。资本市场层面，标普道琼斯指数调整成长股与价值股的划分规则，将触发一轮风格再平衡；市场对美伊冲突升级的担忧推动油价全周收高，美国家庭雇主医保年均费用达 2.83 万美元、同比上涨 5%。印度市场监管机构则责令期权讲师及其学院向学员退还约 54.6 亿卢比（约 5750 万美元）。整体看，AI 叙事没有降温，但资本市场开始给它标价：谁在为算力付账、账单何时反映到利润表，是接下来两个季度的核心看点。

1. **美银：数据中心支出 2028 年翻倍至 2.1 万亿美元**：AI 基建仍是资本开支主引擎，电力与设备交付速度成为新瓶颈。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxOSjJIVzNjUS1NU0VqTDNJTm10djYzSVFBVkZuR2xlbmF3MHdyR1hLeWlOclg5Q1dtUGFINVhkc1RXakZ2QXhJdlpVSk5DVEk1XzRuSjhuRVJFMGhyaWFUZThoLUlLZXNTd3RuYUhGM2dGWUxNU0VHeC1CRjROUjVnVmRBWDZhTmFWMVlJUFJZbWZWSS1lNEk2NHdMU2lFcUJSN2ZFWA?oc=5)

2. **亚马逊云容量售罄至 2027 年**：贾西称 2028 年也已有大量容量被预定，仅保留按需实例与推理的余量。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxOeDBNbTdvV2F5U2tSX1NQWmZ2bnRGUXJMRE4xT1V3V0dIcnlFd3g0WkZ6aWdYNmNzNWxIQXNOcWxMdFlqbFNmN3lWekFUOGJVQzN5aElzeVlveVh4RzZ5aC03b3pSLUNQQ21lQ29jNVkwdmF4V2YwYUlkd0dPdkJQT1VwWF9lZUdhZnBrNWppME81Y2Q2ZzFYOWcwWFozajYyME9BQkpSZHNOTTdQX3hTcXF3RkVSS2s3OU1F?oc=5)

3. **Meta 财报强劲但 Muse 曝数据泄露**：新类别股票与广告业务支撑业绩，模型数据泄露则给"生态扩张"叙事添了风险项。[原文](https://ai2roi.substack.com/p/ai-to-roi-news-and-analysis-october-ddb)

4. **美国运通上调利润预期并裁减约 5% 员工**：消费韧性支撑业绩指引，同时以效率优先收缩人力。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxPeldMNkpFRVBpTW1jQjdoSVBaMFg3VzVvUkZ3X2hqNmp0VjZwamlOQkxGLTlOTFQxUFVOc01wU0NhRFJESDBYTTlTZXFNUFNpQ0NVd0lSQXJEcmpoVlVLNkZnMWRhSmRrak5uajBkbFpmOUV2bnQ2V1NEdWdEdmJORDFySVlodDYtTFdVbjR0S3IzVjQyVUN3Z0Y1NEh6U3otM2c0QmZ5RlNQYkt0c1JLVkpkVGVNZnR2RkpJZGpZZw?oc=5)

5. **Infosys 下调指引，北美 IT 支出被 AI 重构**：客户预算从人力外包转向 AI 项目，按人头计费的模式出现收入缺口。[原文](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQNWdWWnJFN3I3MnZQQzBBRUFVMnBTbkduVklRcFVPbWZVTGFxM2NRbkRtRHlXa2JBdlpnQWMxSkh1WU91clBJQnpqYXItXzAtcTJ5NlFETjRETndtM2VyRGxkaElVREFxRjRfeUdkMzlxR3hYdlZSX1R1LXNRX3dxTUlyYzJNYUp1NGpfOU5mNUQ0YWZ3bE1TOVAxaUk?oc=5)

items.title: US LNG Project Developer Funded by Russia’s Novatek, FT Says
items.summary: A developer of a liquefied natural gas facility in Alaska received financing from Russia-based Novatek PJSC, an energy giant that is subject to US sanctions, the Financial Times reported.

items.summary: Kenya has reported a second death from Ebola, a 65-year-old woman who was a close family member of the index case.

items.summary: India’s market regulator has ordered options trader Avadhut Sathe and his trading academy to refund 5.46 billion rupees ($57.5 million) to course participants after finding they provided unregistered investment advice and research services under the guise of stock market education.
